rule: Test-R: HUC2 regions in sha1 order (skip regions > 20% of rows) until 8%-15% of rows; Test-S: 20-km blocks of the rest in sha1 order until 15% of their rows; non-test sites within 5 km of any test site -> buffer (unused); dev folds: 5 folds over 20-km and 5-km blocks (largest first to the lightest fold) + leave-HUC2-out
